qualityBar: Regular-season, sourced first-since / franchise-first / never-before game feats. 20-40 facts.

facts.headline: First reverse natural cycle in Cubs history
facts.notes: HR-3B-2B-1B in that order. Sarah Langs: 5th reverse cycle in the expansion era (since 1961). Wikipedia/SABR: 9th reverse natural cycle in the modern era (since 1900).

facts.headline: First MLB reverse cycle since Rajai Davis in 2016
facts.notes: Langs list since 1961: Fregosi 1968, Luke Scott 2006-07-28, Carlos Gomez 2008-05-07, Davis 2016-07-02, PCA 2026-06-15.

facts.headline: First Cubs cycle in first four PAs since Andre Dawson, 1987
facts.notes: Elias. Also first Cubs cycle since Carson Kelly 2025-03-31; 13th cycle in Cubs history; first MLB cycle of 2026; first MLB cycle since Byron Buxton 2025-07-12.

facts.headline: First Phillies cycle since Weston Wilson, 2024
facts.notes: First career cycle. 11th cycle in Phillies history (10th player; Chuck Klein did it twice). Completed with a 5th-inning triple.

facts.line: 4-5 | 3 HR (2 in the 3rd inning), 6 RBI, 4 R
facts.headline: First teammates to combine for a cycle and 3+ HR since 1932

previous.player: Lou Gehrig (4 HR) and Tony Lazzeri (cycle)

facts.notes: Elias via Sarah Langs. Harper cycled; Schwarber hit 3 HR including two in the 3rd (456 and 457 ft). Schwarber's 5th career 3-HR game; franchise-leading 4th 3-HR game as a Phillie. 4th Phillie with 2 HR in one inning (Turner 2023-08-19, Von Hayes 1985-06-11, Seminick 1949-06-02). 2nd MLB player in 2026 with 2 HR in an inning (after Alvarez 2026-06-12).

facts.line: 4-hit cycle; 2B in 3rd, 1B in 5th, HR and 3B in 7th (No. 9 hitter)
facts.headline: First White Sox cycle since José Abreu, 2017
facts.notes: 7th White Sox cycle. 5th player since 1900 to cycle from the 9-hole. 3rd since 1961 to complete a cycle with two hits in the same inning (Felix Pie 2009-08-14, Jim Ray Hart 1970-07-08). First Canadian cycle since George Kottaras 2011-09-03. AP's later cycle roundup listed July 11; game recaps and Wikipedia use July 10.

facts.headline: First Reds road cycle since Heinie Groh, 1915
facts.notes: 8th cycle in Reds history; first Reds cycle since Elly De La Cruz 2023-06-23 vs Braves. First Reds road cycle since Groh at Wrigley, Game 2 of a DH. Elly also went 4-6 a triple shy of a cycle; would have been first game since 1900 with two cycles.

facts.headline: First Padres 5-single game since Adrián González, 2009
facts.notes: First 5-hit game of Tatis's career. First MLB player in 2026 with 5 singles in a game.

facts.headline: First 5-hit game by a Braves catcher since Johnny Estrada, 2004
facts.notes: First career 5-hit game. First Braves player with 2 HR in a 5-hit game since Ozzie Albies 2021-06-30; only other 21st-century Atlanta 5-hit 2-HR games: Andruw Jones 2006, Gary Sheffield 2003. Riley also had a 2-HR game the same afternoon.

facts.headline: First 3-HR game at T-Mobile Park by a Mariner
facts.notes: Only prior 3-HR game at T-Mobile (opened 1999) was visitor Victor Martinez, CLE, 2004-07-16. First Mariners catcher 3-HR game since manager Dan Wilson 1996-04-11. 13th player in Mariners history with a 3-HR game. Last Mariners 3-HR game anywhere: Dominic Canzone 2025-09-16 at KC. Last Mariners home 3-HR game before this: Edgar Martinez 1999-05-18 at the Kingdome.

facts.headline: First Mariners catcher 3-HR game since Dan Wilson, 1996
facts.notes: First 3-HR game of Raleigh's career. All 3 pulled from the left side.

facts.headline: First Dodger 3-HR walk-off game since Don Demeter, 1959
facts.notes: Elias. First MLB 3-HR game including a walk-off since Jack Suwinski 2022-06-19. MLB.com: first player ever with 5+ R, 4+ H, 3+ HR and a walk-off HR in the same game. Second career 3-HR game for Muncy.

facts.line: 3-5 | 2 HR in the 1st inning (2-run + grand slam), 6 RBI
facts.headline: First player ever with a grand slam and a multi-run HR in the 1st inning
facts.notes: AP/Sportradar. First 2-HR first inning since David Ortiz 2008-08-12. Since RBI became official in 1920, only Alvarez and Ortiz have 2 HR and 6 RBI in a first inning (ESPN Research). 3rd Astro with 2 HR in an inning (Lee May 1974-04-29, Jeff Bagwell 1994-06-24). 8th player with a slam + multi-run HR in one inning; first since Kendrys Morales 2012.

facts.headline: First 2-HR first inning since David Ortiz, 2008
Youngest Tigers 3-HR game since Al Kaline, 1955
facts.notes: Keith 24 years, 305 days. Kaline was 20 years, 119 days. First career 3-HR game. Last Tigers 3-HR game: Kerry Carpenter 2025-06-02 at CWS (short window; the Kaline age mark is the historic one).

facts.headline: Most RBI by a Cub in a game since Sammy Sosa, 2002
facts.notes: Sosa had 9 RBI in 2002; exact Sosa game date not re-checked here. 8 RBI is 2nd-most in MLB history from a No. 9 hitter. Most HRs by a Cubs 9-hole hitter. First Cub with back-to-back multi-HR games since Patrick Wisdom 2021-08-27/28. Cubs scored 23, most in a home game since 1977; 8 team HR tied franchise record then set 2025-07-04.

facts.headline: First Cubs player since 1900 with 3 HR and multiple walks in a game
facts.notes: Sarah Langs: 20th MLB player since 1900 with 3 HR and multiple walks. First career 3-HR game. 2nd Cubs 3-HR game of 2026 after Swanson 2026-07-01.

facts.line: 3-6 | 3 HR, 4 RBI (Cubs 9 HR as a team)
facts.headline: Cubs set franchise record with 9 HR in a game
facts.notes: Broke the 8-HR franchise mark set 2025-07-04 vs STL and matched 2026-07-01 vs SDP. Ties 2nd-most by one MLB team in a game since 1900 (Blue Jays 10 on 1987-09-14). Bregman's 2nd 3-HR game of August.

facts.headline: First career 3-HR game; first Cub to HR in 1st and 2nd then HR again since Soriano, 2007
facts.notes: Not the first Cubs 3-HR game of 2026 (Swanson 07-01, Bregman 08-12). Bleed Cubbie Blue: only subsequent Cub after Soriano 2007 to homer in the 1st and 2nd, then homer again. Player-career first 3-HR.

facts.headline: 2 HR and a triple in one game
facts.notes: Confirmed via MLB Stats API game log and B-R box. MLB.com bio: first MLB 2 HR + 3B since Seiya Suzuki 2024-08-24 at MIA, then PCA himself 2025-04-13 at LAD. Rare combo, but the 2026 game is not a long MLB drought. Same night he passed Billy Williams (42 HR in 1970) for Cubs LHH single-season HR record (44).

facts.headline: First Braves 2-HR, 2-SB game since Ender Inciarte, 2017
facts.notes: 4th Braves player: Chipper Jones 1999, Rafael Furcal 2005, Inciarte 2017, Acuña 2026. Grant McAuley/B-Ref tweet said 23rd player since 1898 — that count conflicts with StatMuse (Soto 2025-08-30, Moniak 2025-09-14, Ohtani 2024-09-19). Do not use the '23rd ever' number. MLB previous on StatMuse: Mickey Moniak 2025-09-14.

facts.line: 9 IP, 1 H, 0 ER, 0 BB, 15 K, 95 pitches; faced the minimum
facts.headline: Most K in a Maddux (CGSHO, <100 pitches) since pitch counts tracked (1988)
facts.notes: Broke Skubal's 13-K Maddux. 15 K while facing the minimum tied Erik Bedard 2007-07-07 (Bedard allowed 2 H). First career CG/SHO. First Brewers complete game since Brandon Woodruff 2023-09-11 vs MIA. 104.5 mph: hardest pitch by a starter in the pitch-tracking era (since 2008).

facts.headline: First Brewers complete game since Brandon Woodruff, 2023

facts.line: 9 IP, 5 H, 0 ER, 0 BB, 11 K, 109 pitches
facts.headline: First complete-game shutout since June 5, 2019
facts.notes: First CG in more than seven years (last 2019 with Boston at KC, a 3-hit SHO). 4th career shutout. 17th career CG. Threw 100.1 mph, first 100+ pitch since July 2018.

facts.headline: Youngest Yankee ever with 13 K and 0 BB in a game
facts.notes: Sarah Langs. 25 years, 134 days. Youngest Yankee with 13 K since Al Downing (22y, 359d) on 1964-06-21 vs CWS. First regular-season double-digit K game of his career.

facts.headline: 7.1 scoreless, 12 K, 0 BB at Citizens Bank Park
facts.notes: Confirmed gem from the judge catalog. Career-high remains 13 K on Jun 19. No long-window first-since sourced beyond the outing itself.

facts.headline: 2nd Phillies pitcher since 1900 with 13+ K and 0 BB in a game
facts.notes: Velasquez had a 16-K shutout vs Padres in 2016. Sánchez's 2nd career CGSHO. Exact Velasquez date not re-fetched (widely 2016-04-14).

facts.line: 9 IP, 1 H, 0 ER, 3 BB, 12 K, 120 pitches (CGSHO)
facts.headline: First Blue Jays 1-hit CGSHO since Brandon Morrow, 2010
facts.notes: First visiting 1-hit CGSHO at Fenway since Félix Hernández in 2007. First Blue Jays complete game of 2026. No-hit bid broken by Andruw Monasterio double in the 6th.

facts.headline: First Royals 1-hit shutout since Zack Greinke, 2009
facts.notes: 2nd Royals CGSHO of 2026 (Stephen Kolek in May; exact Kolek date not sourced here). First time since 2014 the Royals had multiple pitchers with CGSHOs. Perfect through 5; walk in 6th; single in 7th.

facts.player: Tatsuya Imai / Steven Okert / Alimber Santa
facts.line: Combined no-hitter, 9-0 (Imai 6 IP, Okert 1 IP, Santa 2 IP in MLB debut)
facts.headline: First MLB no-hitter since Sept. 4, 2024

previous.player: Shota Imanaga, Nate Pearson, Porter Hodge

facts.notes: First CG no-hitter still Blake Snell 2024-08-02. First Astros no-hitter since Ronel Blanco 2024-04-01. ESPN/Elias: Santa first pitcher since 1900 to appear in a no-hitter in his MLB debut (Bumpus Jones threw a solo no-hitter in his 1892 debut). MLB.com called it Houston's 18th no-hitter; ESPN said 17th regular-season — treat franchise count as medium.

facts.line: 6 IP, 2 H, 1 ER, 2 BB, 10 K (did not bat)
facts.headline: First regular-season 10-K start as a Dodger
facts.notes: LA Times: matched his 10 K in 2025 NLCS Game 4 vs MIL. First outing in which he did not also bat since 2021. Confirmed from judge catalog. Not a long-window MLB first-since.

facts.line: 9 IP, 2 H, 0 ER, 1 BB, 12 K (first career CGSHO)
facts.headline: First career complete game, in start No. 150
facts.notes: Never pitched into the 9th in first 149 starts. Game time 1:51, fastest in MLB in 2026. Not a long franchise drought (Sánchez CGSHO 2026-05-16).

facts.line: 3-4 | 3 HR in first 3 AB (first pitch of debut), 5 RBI, 3 R
facts.headline: First player ever with 3 homers in an MLB debut
facts.notes: Homered in each of his first three career at-bats, also a first. 9th player with 2 HR in his first regular-season game. 2nd player since 1900 to homer in his first two career at-bats in one game, joining Bob Nieman (St. Louis Browns, 1951-09-14). 33rd player to homer on his first career pitch. First Cardinals 3-HR game since Nolan Arenado 2022-07-01 (short window; the debut mark is the historic one).

facts.line: HR on the first pitch he saw, 449 ft
facts.headline: First Cardinals position player to homer on his first pitch since Chris Richard, 2000
facts.notes: MLB.com stats page also: first Cardinals player (any position) to homer on the first pitch of his first career at-bat since Adam Wainwright 2006-05-24. Richard is the position-player first-since from the debut recap.

facts.headline: First Pirate ever with 10 RBI in a game
facts.notes: Broke the club record of 9 RBI set by Rizzo vs STL. 17th player in the modern era (since 1900) with 10+ RBI in a game; first since Shohei Ohtani 2024-09-19 (too short for an MLB first-since headline). 11th with 3 HR and 10 RBI in a game since RBI became official in 1920. Helmet to Cooperstown. Bid for a 4th HR ended with a 9th-inning single off infielder Jorge Mateo.

facts.line: Immaculate 1st (9 pitches, 9 strikes, 3 K); 6 IP, 4 H, 0 ER, 1 BB, 7 K
facts.headline: First Red Sox to open a game with an immaculate inning since Pedro Martínez, 2002
facts.notes: K'd Nick Loftin (called), Bobby Witt Jr. (swinging), Jac Caglianone (swinging). 8th immaculate inning in Red Sox history; 2nd in the first inning. Most recent Red Sox immaculate in any inning: Chris Sale 2021-08-26 vs MIN (5-year window; skip that first-since). Rain-delayed Fenway start, like Martínez vs SEA.

facts.line: Immaculate 5th (Cortes, Serven, Bolte); 6.2 IP, 7 H, 4 ER, 1 BB, 11 K
facts.headline: First immaculate inning in Twins history
facts.notes: MLB.com: first on record in Twins history. Tied a career-high 11 K. Rangers then stood alone as the only current club without an immaculate inning. Twins lost 4-2 at Sutter Health Park.

facts.line: Immaculate 5th (Báez, Carpenter, Torres); 5 IP, 4 H, 0 ER, 1 BB, 10 K
facts.headline: First Diamondbacks immaculate inning since Wade Miley, 2012
facts.notes: 4th in franchise history (Randy Johnson 2001-09-02, Byung-Hyun Kim 2002-05-11, Miley 2012-10-01). First D-backs pitcher to throw one in his debut start with the club. Most K by a pitcher in a Diamondbacks debut, passing Johnson's 9 in 1999. AZ Central misdated Miley as 2012-04-25; Baseball Almanac, Wikipedia, and MLB video use 2012-10-01 vs COL.

facts.headline: First Cubs player with a leadoff and walk-off homer in the same game
facts.notes: First-pitch leadoff HR off Luis Castillo; 2-run walk-off off Hagen Smith in the 10th. Also locked a second straight 30-30 season. ESPN: first time in franchise history.

facts.headline: First MLB leadoff and walk-off homer since Chris Young, 2010
facts.notes: Elias: 6th player ever. Prior: Vic Power 1957-05-07, Darin Erstad 2000-06-25, Reed Johnson 2003-06-15, Ian Kinsler 2009-07-19, Young 2010-08-07. Elias excludes Billy Hamilton 1893 (HR came in the top of the 10th). Randy Arozarena did it five days later.

facts.headline: First Mariners player with a leadoff and walk-off homer in the same game
facts.notes: 7th MLB player ever; 5 days after PCA. Sarah Langs: 3rd with a first-pitch leadoff HR and a walk-off HR in the same game (Vic Power 1957, PCA 2026-08-17). Skip the MLB first-since (same week). Also robbed a homer from Miguel Amaya.

facts.headline: First player ever to pinch-hit, then homer twice in one inning
facts.notes: OptaSTATS / Wikipedia 2026 season page. Entered as a PH for Ali Sánchez in the 6th (sac fly), then homered off Jovani Morán and infielder Andruw Monasterio (49.8 mph slider) in a 9-run 8th. First Yankee with 2 HR in an inning since Gleyber Torres 2022-09-21 (too short). 6th Yankee / 7th instance.

facts.line: 2-5 | RBI 1B, 2-run walk-off HR in the 10th (MLB debut)
facts.headline: First walk-off homer in an MLB debut since Carlos Pérez, 2015
facts.notes: Elias: 5th player ever. Prior: Billy Parker 1971, Josh Bard 2002, Miguel Cabrera 2003-06-20, Pérez 2015-05-05. Called up from Triple-A Charlotte the same day. Walk-off off Raisel Iglesias, 343 ft.

facts.line: 2 IP, 0 H, 0 ER, 0 BB, 1 K (MLB debut; combined no-hitter)
facts.headline: First pitcher since 1900 to appear in a no-hitter in his MLB debut
facts.notes: Elias via ESPN/MLB.com. Jones threw a solo no-hitter in his 1892 debut. Santa closed the Imai/Okert/Santa combined no-hitter with two perfect innings. The no-hitter itself is already cataloged; this is the debut-appearance first.

facts.headline: First A's catcher with an inside-the-park homer since Terry Steinbach, 1996
facts.notes: Elias via MLB.com: 15th A's multi-HR game including an inside-the-parker; 5th in the division era (Jackson 1969, Bando 1973, Williams 1975, Butler 2025-07-08, Langeliers). 8th such game at Wrigley Field, first since Ryne Sandberg 1991-07-27. A's lost 7-6 walk-off. Catcher-primary first-since is the long-window headline; Butler 2025 is an OF, so skip as too short for the generic ITP+HR club mark.

facts.headline: First Rockies player with two 3-HR games in a season
facts.notes: Second 3-HR game of 2026 (also 2026-06-27 at MIN). Larry Walker (3 career), Todd Helton, and Carlos González had multiple 3-HR games but never two in one season. Rockies lost 9-6. Season-mark completed in this game.

facts.headline: First NL 3-HR game at Yankee Stadium since Interleague began in 1997
facts.notes: MLB.com. First visiting 3-HR game at Yankee Stadium since Jordan Diaz 2023-05-09 (too short). First Cardinals 3-HR game since Iván Herrera 2025-04-02 (too short). The Interleague-era NL mark is the long window. 0 doubles / 0 triples / 0 SB / 0 BB.

facts.headline: First Rays 3-HR game since Isaac Paredes, 2022
facts.notes: 8th three-homer game in Rays history. First career 3-HR game. 0 doubles / 0 triples / 0 SB / 0 BB. Earlier skip of this game is superseded now that the Paredes date is sourced.

facts.line: 22-0 shutout; 22 H; 3-run HR from Yelich, Hamilton, Lara
facts.headline: Tied the modern-era record for largest shutout, 22-0
facts.notes: Since 1901 the only other 22-0 wins: Pittsburgh at Chicago Cubs 1975-09-16 and Cleveland at Yankees 2004-08-31. Matched a Brewers franchise record for runs in a game. Kyle Harrison 5 IP, 0 ER, 8 K in the start.

skippedNotHistoric.fact: Only Mets HR vs Phillies, 3-5 | HR, 2B, Sep 18
skippedNotHistoric.reason: Line confirmed (3-run HR in 6th, Mets 6-3). Not a long-window first-since / franchise-first game feat.
Skip per brief if not historic. No sourced first-since found.
Line confirmed (2 HR, 4 RBI, Padres 8-1 sweep). Multi-HR games are common; no long-window first-since sourced.

skippedNotHistoric.fact: 4 hits and a steal @ Pirates, Jul 25
skippedNotHistoric.reason: Line confirmed via Stats API: 4-5, HR, 2 2B, SB, 3 RBI (triple shy of a cycle). No sourced MLB/franchise first-since.

skippedNotHistoric.fact: 3 hits and a steal @ Nationals, Jun 16
4-6 | HR, 2B same night as Bleday's cycle, Aug 22
skippedNotHistoric.reason: Triple shy of a cycle. Would have been first game since 1900 with two cycles — already noted on the Bleday fact. Incomplete feat; do not catalog as a first.
First Dodger 3-HR since Muncy 2026-04-10 (26 days). First Dodger with 3 HR and 6 RBI since Ohtani 2024-09 vs MIA — prior-year window. Skip.

skippedNotHistoric.fact: 2 HR and 2 SB at STL, Aug 8
skippedNotHistoric.reason: Confirmed 4-5 | 2 HR, 2 SB. MLB last before this is Acuña 2026-05-30 (70 days). No sourced Rockies long-window first-since. Combo table lastPlayer is McCarthy; do not catalog as a first-since.
Career high; tied Marlins franchise record rather than setting a first. Not a club first or long first-since.

skippedNotHistoric.fact: HR + inside-the-park HR at COL, Jul 17
skippedNotHistoric.reason: Confirmed 2-HR night including an ITP. No sourced long-window franchise/MLB first-since.
First Korean-born MLB player with 5 hits (Korean press). Nationality first, not a Giants/MLB long-window game feat for this catalog.
Second D-backs immaculate of 2026 after Soroka Mar 30. Same-season first-since; skip.
No sourced Guardians club-first or 7+ year first-since.

skippedNotHistoric.fact: 2 HR in MLB debut, Mar 26 / Mar 31
skippedNotHistoric.reason: 7th and 8th players to do it. Rare but not a first, and two in one week. Báez's 3-HR debut is the historic debut-HR mark.

skippedNotHistoric.fact: 7 consecutive walks in the 2nd vs CIN, May 2
skippedNotHistoric.reason: Tied the MLB record last done 1983-05-25 (also vs Atlanta pitching to Pittsburgh) and 1909-08-28. Historic, but a team walk sequence with no single-player hero for a live box join. Left out of facts[].

searchedNotFound: No 4-HR games in 2026 through Sep 19 (Wikipedia 21 all-time, last Kyle Schwarber 2025-08-28; StatMuse season high is 3 HR, 13 players / 15 games).

No 3 HR + 2 doubles in 2026. Last: Shohei Ohtani 2024-09-19. Five ever since 1901 (Bryant 2016, Carpenter 2018, Dickerson 2020, García 2023, Ohtani 2024). Not first-since-1918; Bryant was the modern-era first.
No 3 HR + triple in 2026. Last: Kendrys Morales 2015-09-20 (7 since 1901).
No 3 HR + steal in 2026. Last: Shohei Ohtani 2024-09-19 (also the only 3 HR + 2 SB). Previous 3 HR + 1 SB: Paul Goldschmidt 2023-05-07.
No sourced 6-hit games in 2026 (StatMuse: 15 players tied at 5 hits). Last 6-hit: Nick Kurtz 2025-07-25.
No 5 extra-base-hit games in 2026 (season high 4, Jac Caglianone 2026-08-08). Last 5 XBH: Nick Kurtz 2025-07-25 (16 since 1901).
No cycle + steal in 2026 (PCA, Harper, Peters, Bleday all 0 SB). Last: Elly De La Cruz 2023-06-23. Previous: Trea Turner 2021-06-30 (2 SB).
No 3-triple games in 2026 (StatMuse last: Xavier Edwards 2024-09-27).
No additional cycles after Bleday 2026-08-22 (AP 2026 cycle list; Wikipedia cycle list through Bleday as #353).
No complete-game no-hitter in 2026; only the Astros combined no-hitter May 25 (ESPN no-hitters / 2026).
Andy Pages 3 HR 2026-05-06 is first Dodger 3-HR since Muncy 2026-04-10 (too short).
Last Dodgers regular-season 3-HR game before 2026: Will Smith 2024-07-05 vs MIL; Ohtani also had 3 HR + 10 RBI vs MIA in September 2024. Muncy 2026-04-10 is already cataloged.
No sourced Mets/Giants/Yankees (aside from Wells pinch-2HR) long-window 2026 single-game firsts that clear the bar.
unverifiedOrConflicting: Acuña '23rd player since 1898 with 2 HR and 2 SB' (Grant McAuley / Baseball-Reference tweet) conflicts with StatMuse rows for Soto (2025-08-30), Moniak (2025-09-14), and Ohtani (2024-09-19). Use franchise first-since Inciarte 2017; do not publish the 23rd-ever number.
Dansby Swanson 8 RBI 'most by a Cub since Sosa had 9 in 2002' — year is sourced; exact Sosa game date not pulled.
Cristopher Sánchez '2nd Phillie since 1900 with 13 K / 0 BB' — sourced to NBCSP; Velasquez comparison year 2016, exact date not re-fetched.
Astros no-hitter franchise count: ESPN 17th regular-season vs MLB.com 18th.
Tristan Peters cycle date: game recaps July 10; some later roundups say July 11.
PCA 3-HR 'first Cub to HR in 1st and 2nd then again since Soriano 2007' is from Bleed Cubbie Blue, not Elias/MLB.com — medium confidence; Soriano year 2007 not a full date.
